note: Parser quirk, not a supported syntax: a bare ~id after a path is an MRFI (refused when invalid); a review id is only read after a second ~ (file~~<id>). New spec: that id matches any unique prefix of an item id of the target file, case-insensitive, with or without rvw_, as in agent show/respond/apply. The Deno tool only accepted the full id or the exact short id computed over the target file, so a longer prefix (such as the project-wide short id of critique list or the VS Code panel) was reported missing.
